title: Chimero
summary: A local-first desktop app for tracking anything about your life: a dashboard you arrange, trackers you can design, logging in seconds, and statistics that never claim more than the data supports.
role: Product, interface design and full-stack engineering
highlights: Composable 12-column dashboard: drag, resize, collisions, keyboard moves, saved layouts
Custom trackers with templates, goals, units and up to twelve fields
Quick Entry from anywhere with Alt+Q, with a form fitted to each kind of record
Correlation scan with a false-discovery-rate correction; missing days are never zero
Upgrades tested against the previous release's database, with a copy taken first
171 unit and integration tests, plus end-to-end tests on the packaged app

screenshots.alt: Today dashboard with mood, sleep, tasks, weight, a pinned insight, water and a logging streak
Dashboard in edit mode with remove buttons and resize handles on each widget
Quick Entry dialog for Mood with a 1 to 10 scale
Weight tracker page with fitted trend, goal line and history
Workout entry started from a Push routine with sets, reps and load
Insights comparing sleep and mood on the same day, with the list of patterns found
Insights comparing dairy with bloating on the next day
Journal month calendar with the records of the selected day
People page with a fictional contact's details and nudge settings
A custom Sleep tracker with statistics, chart and goal
New tracker builder started from the Meditation template
Today dashboard in the light theme

publicationNote: All screenshots are captures of the running app with a synthetic, fictional profile. Client-context documents in the repository are not part of this showcase and need the client's approval before publication.
